program_name: GMCC: Crown No Income Doc/No Ratio (DTA)

additional_rules.description: GMCC Crown — In-house asset qualifier: no job, no income doc, no ratio. Qualifies on DTA (total debts / qualified assets), max 70%. AZ, CA, NJ, NY — no county limits. Pilot program: complete the biweekly training/certification to use it (email production@gmccloan.com to sign up).
additional_rules.income_docs: None. No employment or income information on the 1003.
additional_rules.dta_max: 70% — debts (subject loan amount, all credit-report balances, alimony/child support, all REO loan balances) / qualified assets.
additional_rules.qualified_assets: 1 month bank statement. US personal accounts (joint with family OK with 100% access letter), life-insurance cash value 100%, retirement 60%, living/revocable trust assets. Foreign assets at 50%, capped at 50% of qualified assets. US REO: refinance subject uses net equity; purchase subject can't count. Business funds not allowed.
additional_rules.loan_amount: Max $5M owner-occupied purchase or refinance; max $3M for all other transactions (including cash-out). Cash on hand max $3M. Loans under $200K are priced on the rate sheet (with a loan-amount adjustment) — confirm before quoting.
additional_rules.terms: 3/6 and 5/6 ARM only (1-year SOFR, 3% margin). No fixed rate. Qualifying rate = fully indexed rate (reserves).
additional_rules.credit: Min FICO 660, no rescore. Min 1 year US credit with 2 active tradelines ≥ 12 months. 0x30x12 housing. Credit events 7 years.
additional_rules.borrowers: US citizens, green card holders, non-permanent residents with valid visa/EAD/I-94. Foreign nationals with SSN/ITIN meeting FICO and tradeline rules. Revocable trust OK, POA OK (incl. cash-out), FTHB and non-occupant co-borrower OK. No LLC vesting.
additional_rules.reserves: 12 months PITIA in a US bank account (+6 months above the LTV triggers in the matrix). Gift funds and cash-out proceeds can't be reserves.
additional_rules.gift_funds: Purchase/R&T, all occupancies: up to 30% of the lower of price or appraised value, max 3 donors (OFAC checked). Closing costs only on R&T; not on cash-out.
additional_rules.large_deposits: Source deposits ≥ 5% of the purchase price.
additional_rules.delayed_financing: Priced as cash-out; LTV/loan amount per the purchase matrix.
additional_rules.properties: SFR, 2–4 units, attached/detached PUD, warrantable condos (full review, min 500 sq ft), up to 10 acres. Ineligible: leasehold, co-ops, manufactured, brick foundation.
additional_rules.appraisal: 2 appraisals when the loan amount is over $2M. Transferred appraisals not allowed.
additional_rules.other: Impounds required. Max 10 loans / $8M aggregate per borrower. No limit on financed properties for a primary; 10 for 2nd home and investment. Max comp 3% (TRID). EPO 12 months.

general_notes: GMCC Crown — In-house asset qualifier (Standard AQ): no job, no income doc, no ratio. Qualify with DTA (total debts / qualified assets), max 70%.
Pilot program: complete the biweekly training/certification to use it — email production@gmccloan.com to sign up.
Lending states: AZ, CA, NJ, NY — no county limits.
Primary, second home and investment; purchase, rate/term and cash-out.
Max loan $5M owner-occupied purchase/refi; $3M for everything else (cash-out max $3M, cash on hand max $3M). Max 60% LTV (to $2M).
3/6 and 5/6 ARM only (1-year SOFR, 3% margin). No fixed rate.
Min FICO 660; 0x30x12 housing; 1 year US credit with 2 tradelines.
Assets: 1 month bank statement; large deposits sourced at 5% of price. Reserves 12 months PITIA in a US account.
Gift funds up to 30% of the lower of price/appraisal, max 3 donors. Cash-out proceeds and gifts can't be reserves.
Citizens, green card holders, visa holders and EAD OK; foreign nationals with SSN/ITIN meeting credit rules. POA OK including cash-out.
Warrantable condos only; no co-ops, leasehold or manufactured homes. 2 appraisals over $2M.
